Staff briefings and a warm welcome
The desk is glad to help at dawn
Traveler notice for animal moves

Travelers must report any pet travel concern to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at once, especially if plans change or a carrier is delayed. The desk will check the file, guide the next step, and keep animal welfare first in every case.

Handlers use calm, humane methods around animals, and the senior coordinator reviews service choices when a trip needs extra care. The welfare coordinator checks comfort needs, while the ground team moves carriers carefully between services. If a missed connection affects your journey, please see the desk staff for the normal claim steps and the current file record. <<FACT F110>>

Keep travel papers ready, follow loading directions, and stay close to staff if your animal needs support during transfer. Do not leave a carrier unattended, and do not make last-minute changes without telling the desk. Clear notice helps Aurelia Skyways protect animal comfort and keep the handoff orderly.

Please go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk now for direct help and record checks.
